recognize_zh: 視野內多數為中型淋巴細胞，細胞核圓、染色質中度濃縮，部分核中央可見小核仁，細胞質淡藍呈中等量（前淋巴球）；旁邊有小型成熟淋巴球、一個嗜中性球與一個粗顆粒嗜鹼性球作為大小對照。
features: Medium-sized lymphoid cells with round nuclei, moderately condensed chromatin, and moderate pale-blue cytoplasm
Several cells show a small but visible central nucleolus (prolymphocytes)
Small mature lymphocyte with dense chromatin at the top center for size comparison
Segmented neutrophil and a basophil with coarse dark granules in the upper cluster
Background red cells with scattered platelets
describe_en: The smear shows a population of medium-sized lymphoid cells with round nuclei, moderately condensed chromatin, small central nucleoli in a subset, and moderate amounts of pale-blue cytoplasm, consistent with prolymphocytes, together with occasional small mature lymphocytes. A segmented neutrophil and a basophil are also present. No smudge cells are prominent in this field. Findings are consistent with chronic lymphocytic leukemia with increased prolymphocytes, supported by the case immunophenotype.

ddx.vs: B-PLL shows a predominance (>55%) of prolymphocytes with prominent nucleoli and a CD5-weak, CD23-negative, FMC7/CD20-bright phenotype, whereas this case is CD5+/CD23+/FMC7-negative.
Leukemic mantle cell lymphoma may contain nucleolated cells but is cyclin D1/SOX11-positive and usually CD23-negative.
T-PLL cells have basophilic cytoplasmic blebs and irregular nuclei and express T-cell markers (CD3, CD7) with TCL1 rearrangement rather than CD19/CD20.
